SECTION_DISPLAY_DESC: What the screen shows when CoreZoneDisplay starts.
DISPLAY_MODE_DOC: Clock Only: the screen always shows the clock. Player Menu + Clock When Idle: shows the music player, and switches to the clock after a period of no activity.
SECTION_SCREENSAVER_DESC: When to switch from the player menu to the clock. Used only in 'Player Menu + Clock When Idle' mode.
ENABLE_SCREENSAVER_DOC: Switch to the clock automatically when nobody touches the screen.
PREVENT_SCREENSAVER_PLAYING_DOC: Keep the Now Playing screen (album art and controls) while music plays. The clock appears only after playback is paused or stopped.
IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: How many seconds without activity before the clock appears.
ACTIVE_CLOCK_DOC: MainClockSelector.html lets you choose and switch between all clock designs on the display itself.
SECTION_RADIO_DESC: Five quick-play radio buttons shown in the player. Enter a name and a stream address for each.
SECTION_LINKS_DESC: Open these addresses in a browser to view the display or customize the clock.
DISPLAY_URL_DOC: Open this address in any browser or kiosk screen to show CoreZoneDisplay.
CLOCK_SETTINGS_URL_DOC: Open this address to change the Digital Clock layout, Hebrew date and colors.
